options: I want to read more about it.

conversation.transcript:
Student: Did you finish the reading assignment for history?
Professor: Yes, I completed it last night. Did you find it challenging?
Student: A bit, especially the part about the ancient cultures.
Professor: That section can be tricky. Would you like to discuss it during office hours?

questions.q: What did the student find challenging?
questions.explain: 學生覺得閱讀作業有挑戰性。

questions.q: What does the professor offer to the student?
options: To meet for a study group.
questions.explain: 教授提供在辦公時間討論的機會。

announcement.transcript: Attention students: The university bookstore will be holding a sale on all textbooks this Friday from 10 AM to 5 PM. Don't miss out on discounts of up to 30%! Make sure to bring your student ID for additional savings.

questions.q: What day is the bookstore sale?
questions.explain: 書店的促銷活動在星期五舉行。

questions.q: What do students need to bring for discounts?
questions.explain: 學生需要帶學生證以獲得額外的折扣。

talk.transcript: Today, we will discuss the concept of renewable energy. Renewable energy comes from sources that are naturally replenished, such as sunlight, wind, and water. Unlike fossil fuels, which can deplete over time, renewable energy sources are sustainable and help reduce carbon emissions. In recent years, many countries have been investing in renewable technologies to combat climate change. Wind turbines and solar panels are two of the most common forms of renewable energy. By harnessing these resources, we can create a cleaner and more sustainable future.

questions.explain: 可再生能源來自自然資源。

questions.q: What do wind turbines and solar panels have in common?
options: They are forms of renewable energy.
questions.explain: 風力發電機和太陽能電池板都是可再生能源的形式。

questions.q: Why are countries investing in renewable technologies?
questions.explain: 國家投資於可再生技術以減少碳排放。

questions.q: What is a key benefit of renewable energy?
options: It can only be used in summer.
questions.explain: 可再生能源的主要好處是幫助對抗氣候變化。
